prompt: Concept image for 'your multiplayer mind palace': a grand but clearly readable floating architecture in black space, built around one bright central core, a large softly glowing mint sphere of light at the heart of a circular atrium. Around it, on three elegant curved terraces of black stone and dark glass, sit distinct rooms of thought: a library of floating glowing cards, a room with a big floating 3D model, a quiet desk with three screens, a garden-like room with a small tree. Thin bridges of light link every room to the core. Several small minimal faceless avatars with soft mint rim light: two stand together sharing one floating hologram, one walks across a bridge of light toward them, one works alone at a desk. Sleek, modern, curved architecture, not a fantasy castle. Clear silhouette, calm, magical. Edges fade fully to black.

Concept image for proximity voice chat in a sleek 3D workspace: two minimal faceless humanoid avatars of smooth matte graphite with mint rim light stand close together beside a floating glass screen, one clearly talking with a gentle open-hand gesture. Soft circular ripples of mint light spread outward from each avatar's head at chest height, like sound, and where the two sets of ripples overlap they glow brighter. Far away to the right, in the dark, a third avatar works alone at a small desk with its own faint separate ripple that does not touch theirs, a clear dark gap between them. Polished black floor with soft reflections. Calm, elegant, cinematic.
